description: This PHP source file defines an OpenCart admin controller class for a module named 'account'. It manages the module's display page and saving configuration settings through appropriate methods, handling permissions, loading necessary views, language strings, and models.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for the 'account' module demonstrating CRUD operations (mainly update) and view rendering for the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data for the module configuration page, loads language, sets page title, breadcrumbs, and components, then renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to save the module configuration, checks permissions, updates settings, and returns success or error message as JSON.
